description: Environment setup and green baseline. Confirm the Flutter toolchain works and the full CI verification suite passes on the new branch BEFORE making changes, so later failures are clearly attributable to this task.
steps: If ~/flutter_sdk does not exist, clone it: git clone --depth 1 --branch 3.47.6 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git ~/flutter_sdk (it is already present in this sandbox).
Export the toolchain for every command: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true.
Run 'flutter pub get'. Then discard autogenerated churn: git checkout -- pubspec.lock analysis_options.yaml and any modified linux/macos/windows plugin registrants and .flutter-plugins-dependencies.

Run the EXACT CI checks (note the trailing dot in format): 'dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .', 'flutter analyze', 'flutter test', 'dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check'.
Record the baseline passing test count (expected 201) in the feature findings.
acceptance_criteria: No autogenerated files (pubspec.lock, analysis_options.yaml, plugin registrants) are left modified in git status
verification: export PATH="$HOME/flutter_sdk/bin:$PATH"; export FLUTTER_SUPPRESS_ANALYTICS=true; dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed . && flutter analyze && flutter test && dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check
git status --porcelain shows a clean tree (no stray autogenerated changes)
findings: Baseline is green on branch feat/paso4-task-pool-marketplace (from main b0d534e). Flutter SDK pre-installed at ~/flutter_sdk (3.47.6, Dart 3.13.5). CI verification results: (1) 'dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed .' -> Formatted 92 files (0 changed), exit 0; (2) 'flutter analyze' -> 'No issues found!', exit 0; (3) 'flutter test' -> All tests passed, 201 passing (baseline = 201); (4) 'dart run tool/architecture/dependency_map.dart --check' -> 'dependency-map.md esta actualizado.', exit 0. No application source changes made. Notes for later features: 'flutter pub get' and 'flutter analyze' both re-modify analysis_options.yaml ('Upgrading analysis_options.yaml to exclude build and platform directories'); 'flutter pub get' also touches pubspec.lock and linux/macos/windows plugin registrant files. These autogenerated changes MUST be discarded with 'git checkout -- analysis_options.yaml pubspec.lock linux/ macos/ windows/' before committing. The 'running as root' warning from flutter is harmless. Working tree left clean (only the untracked .agents/tasks task-state dir remains).
